articles.title_en: Dunk scores screamer as Brighton thrash 10-man Coventry
articles.title_ja: Dunk scores screamer as ブライトン thrash 10-man Coventry
articles.summary_ja: Coventry's poor start to the Premier League season continues after they're thrashed 5-0 at home to ブライトン, having played most of the second half with ten men after having Taiwo Awoniyi sent off at the CBS Arena.
